tagline: Transforming the way the world works
hero_kpi_rationale: Recurring revenue is a key driver of Trimble's trajectory, with 6% growth in 2025, representing 79% of total revenue and demonstrating the success of the service-oriented business model.

kpis.name: Annualized Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Recurring revenue from subscriptions and services.
kpis.description: Recurring revenue represents 79% of total revenue in 2025. Organic ARR growth is 14% excluding the impact of foreign exchange, acquisitions, and divestitures.

kpis.name: Software and Services Revenue Mix
kpis.explanation: Proportion of software, services, and recurring revenue in total revenue.
kpis.description: Software, services, and recurring revenue accounted for 79% of total revenue in 2025, compared to 76% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Increasing share of recurring and software revenue.

kpis.name: Organic ARR Growth
kpis.explanation: ARR growth excluding the impact of foreign exchange, acquisitions, and divestitures.
kpis.description: Organic ARR growth is 14% in 2025, excluding the impact of foreign exchange, acquisitions, and divestitures.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in organic recurring revenue.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions risks related to cyberattacks and disruptions in its systems. A dedicated CISO with specialized expertise manages these risks with a structured team.

risks.title: Macroeconomic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical tensions, trade policies, and tariff restrictions present significant challenges for Trimble's global operations.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Trimble operates in rapidly evolving markets where aggressive competitors target the same customer segments.

risks.title: Regulation and Compliance
risks.score_rationale: Changes in tax, trade, and environmental laws and regulations could impact the company's operations.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: Trimble is highly dependent on its technological capabilities and cloud infrastructure to deliver solutions to customers.

ai_positioning.summary: Trimble mentions artificial intelligence capabilities as part of its broad software suite of 3D modeling, analytics, and design, although AI is not positioned as a distinct strategic pillar.
evidence: Trimble software capabilities include extensive three-dimensional (3D) modeling, analysis, planning and design solutions, and AI capabilities
